notes.title: Steam cloud saves, multiply languages, better controller support, visual improvments!
notes.notes:
We have made a huge update to the game, lots of fixes as well as implementing suggestions from players, adding steam cloud saves (you need to reset your game), some controller improvements and some visuals have been reworked! 

Also many new languages are now supported:

ENG - English 
RUS - Russian 
GER - German 
DAN - Danish 
SPA - Spanish 
FRA - French 
ITA - Italian 
BOS - Bosnian 
HRV - Croatian 
SRP - Serbian

Have fun! ...and the game is still hard! :D
